verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a code-first Python framework: agents are its primary interface, evals are defined entirely in Python, and its interactive surfaces (the clai CLI and the browser chat server) are launched from Agent objects in code. That makes the programmatic API the superset of its UI-like surfaces, but no evidence explicitly states or verifies API/UI parity. missing for 10: an explicit documented parity guarantee between the browser/CLI chat surfaces and the API, coverage of the adjacent Logfire/Gateway UIs via API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
